text: I have adhd and wanted to try this app out to help me remember to do chores around the house on a set schedule because I forget things easily. Being able to repeat tasks is a premium feature, this is very dissapointing and rather ableist..

The subscription comes with an "ADHD tax alert"! Theyll text you if you subscribed but stoped using it. So you don't pay for something you don't use. That's an awesome idea! ATM it's out of my budget, (6,99€/m or 40€/year) but I'll be working on squeezing it in, I believe it might be really useful. Tho I think a trial week or day would be more beneficial than just one task.

This new App exactly responds to what ADHD people get overwhelmed with in doing house chores. It breaks down tasks to the micro level which is so helpful. The videos are short so we can concentrate on them without getting bored. It's also great not to have to read! Very impressed that they will remind you if you're paying for the app and not using it. Looking forward to seeing more content.

Whether or not the developers did it on purpose, the fact that no cancellation is needed for the 30 day free trial (unlike every other app) and you choose to subscribe afterwards is INCREDIBLY underrated for an "ADHD" app.. I only wish that I was able to delete individual tasks/habits from my routines as some of them I don't do or are necessary. Edit: Thanks for your response and letting me know how to delete and change tasks!

A few unusual things about this app. first of all, to order the pro you don't have to put payment details in an actual trial that cancels on its own is genius, especially as it's aimed ADHD people who forget to cancel and end up paying for somet hing they don't use. the second most genius is it's really good in its free format without a million ads and things that are slow me down frustrate me and turn me off about an app. and finally in its Pro format it's a dream with or without ADHD

4/3/21 Looks like they don't listen to reviews as reminders are STILL a "Premium Feature." Thanks for nothing. 10/25/20 I was recently diagnosed with inattentive adhd and was hoping this app would be an answered prayer for help managing the symptoms, but nothing has changed with reminders since my last attempt at using this. Come on Todoist! Reminders should never be a "Premium Feature" in a task management app!!!
